title: Report Re Miss J. Miller Alias Mrs. Jossett Miller

page_data.en:
Form No. 2
G. 21,600-1-31

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

C. & S. B. File No. 2118
Vo. S. B. D. 2118
Stn. 2. 13/3/31 Station,
Date March 13, 1931.

Subject (in full) Miss J. Miller alias Mrs. Jossett Miller.

Made by and Forwarded by D.S.I. Duncan.

Sir,

Miss J. Miller alias Mrs. Jossett Miller is the divorced wife of an American naval officer. She is reported to be a Eurasian of Belgian extraction.

Miss Miller took up residence at the Palace Hotel on November 8th 1930 and resided there until the 21st of that month when she was requested to vacate her room owing to her loose mode of living. She afterwards resided at the Clements' Apartments, No. 1363 Rue Lafayette. She was in the habit of frequenting the lounges of the Cathay and Palace Hotels and in this manner formed acquaintance with male guests whom she invited to her rooms or was herself invited to their rooms.

On the arrival of the S.S. "Belgenland" in Shanghai on February 10th, Miss Miller met a passenger named Rogers and endeavoured to leave with him for Hongkong. She had her luggage taken on board the "Belgenland" but was discovered a few minutes previous to the ship sailing and was sent ashore. The following day she cabled to Rogers stating that she would arrive in Hongkong on the S.S. "Petroclus" on February 15th and asked him to meet her. A reply was requested, but Rogers did not comply with her request and it is not known if he met her on the arrival of the ship at Hongkong or not.

She is not known to have ever been engaged in drug smuggling, and is generally regarded as a woman who makes her living by means of prostitution.

（左侧手写批注：）
Thanks. 889.
Please hold us informed if she leaves Shanghai.
The Police at Hong Kong have been informed.
Information
18/3

D. C. (C. & S. Branches)
D. S. I.

刑事与特别股档案号 2118
伏尔加斯基特别侦探处档案号 2118
第2巡捕房。1931年3月13日 巡捕房，
日期：1931年3月13日。

事由（全称）：J. 米勒小姐，又名乔塞特·米勒夫人。

由副督察邓肯（D.S.I. Duncan）撰写并呈报。

先生，

J. 米勒小姐，又名乔塞特·米勒夫人，系一名美国海军军官的离异妻子。据报她为比利时裔欧亚混血儿。

米勒小姐于1930年11月8日入住华懋饭店（Palace Hotel），并居住至当月21日，因其生活作风放荡而被要求腾退房间。此后，她居住于拉斐德路（Rue Lafayette）1363号克莱门茨公寓（Clements' Apartments）。她惯常出入华懋饭店及汇中饭店（Cathay Hotel）的大厅，并借此结识男性住客，邀请他们前往其房间，或受邀前往他们的房间。

2月10日“贝根兰”号（S.S. "Belgenland"）抵达上海时，米勒小姐结识了一名名为罗杰斯（Rogers）的乘客，并试图随其前往香港。她的行李已被送上“贝根兰”号，但在轮船启航前几分钟被发现，随后被遣送下船。次日，她向罗杰斯发电报，称将于2月15日乘“佩特罗克勒斯”号（S.S. "Petroclus"）抵达香港，并请他接站。她要求回复，但罗杰斯未予理会，目前不知罗杰斯是否在船只抵达香港时与她见面。

未发现她有从事毒品走私的记录，她通常被视为以卖淫为生之女子。

（左侧手写批注：）
谢谢。889。
若其离开上海，请随时告知我方。
已通知香港警方。
情报
18/3

副总监（刑事与特别股）
副督察

Shanghai Municipal Council.
S. B. D. 2118.
9 - 3 - 31.
March 7, 1931.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE.
(COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.)
P. O. Box No. 156

Deputy Commissioner (C. & S. Branches).

In a letter received from Mr. Springfield posted at
Singapore occurs the following:-

"From Shanghai to Hongkong we had a rather suspicious
passenger travelling under the name of Miss J. Miller.
Her story was that she had missed the "Belgeland" yet
she came on board with tons of luggage at the very last
moment in a Marden's motor boat. She behaved in a
most extraordinary way and it struck some of the people
that she was not an American at all but a Russian or
Eurasian, and it just struck me that she was being used
as one of those who travel with dope; anyway no harm
will be done if the "Belgeland" list from America were
checked over. If it was found that she had not come
in the "Belgeland" from America D.S.I. Gash ought to
be able to get some details about her as she tried hard
to attach herself to the "Soccer" Team much to their
annoyance."

Will you please have some enquiries made?

（批：* Sir,
No record in Cr. &
Sp. Br. Reg）

（签名）
Commissioner of Police.

（批：H.C. (SB)
Enquiry please
Rec）

邮政信箱第156号

副总监（刑事与特别股）。

在收到一封从新加坡寄出的斯普林菲尔德先生（Mr. Springfield）的来信中，有以下内容：

“从上海到香港，我们有一位相当可疑的乘客，使用J. 米勒小姐的名字旅行。她的说法是她错过了‘贝格兰’号（"Belgeland"），然而她在最后一刻带着大量行李乘坐马登氏（Marden's）的摩托艇登上了船。她的行为极为反常，令一些人觉得她根本不是美国人，而是俄国人或欧亚混血儿，而我则觉得她是被利用来携带毒品的旅客之一；总之，如果核对一下从美国出发的‘贝格兰’号乘客名单，也不会有什么坏处。如果发现她并非从美国乘坐‘贝格兰’号而来，副督察加什（D.S.I. Gash）应该能够获取关于她的一些细节，因为她曾极力试图依附‘足球’队（"Soccer" Team），令该队成员颇为恼火。”

能否请您安排进行一些查询？

（批：* 先生，
刑事与特别股登记册中无记录）

（签名）
警务处处长。
